headline: Ammo drops now consider weapons received early in Ratchet & Clank randomizers
summary: Archipelago and Item Randomizer now include every owned ammo-using weapon when choosing drops, including weapons received before their normal planet (#187, #188). The original game's low-ammo priorities and pickup counts remain in charge. Auto Swingshot 1.0.0 was also approved for the launcher index (#183, #189). Pressing Circle near a Versa-Target equips the Swingshot automatically, then restores the previous weapon (#182).
highlights: The ammo fixes preserve assigned first-break ammo and the Bomb Glove fallback. Item Randomizer keeps the change limited to an active randomizer seed (#187, #188).
Auto Swingshot supports swinging and pulling targets, airborne chaining and a configurable activation range (#182).
